purpose: Map the reviewed frontier-data hypotheses to existing pinned Speck evidence before source-specific manifest work.
evidence_boundary: This mapping identifies what current local evidence supports and what remains unresolved. It does not establish source rights, correctness, eligible supply, transfer, source admission or training authority.

mappings.supports: Speck already represents pretraining, capability continuation, context extension and post-training as distinct data stages with separate parents, exposures and reservations.
mappings.does_not_support: It does not select stage weights, establish a schedule, or prove that a staged recipe beats a flat mixture.

gate_implications.finite_supply: stage exposure and repetition must be counted

mappings.supports: The web audit records score-stratified extraction defects and coverage candidates, supporting score distributions and coverage review rather than a universal cutoff.
mappings.does_not_support: It does not certify web quality, rights, population-wide overlap or eligible token yield.

mappings.supports: Math parsing and code preflight already expose extraction, notation, provenance and family-specific review requirements.
mappings.does_not_support: Passing a parser, arithmetic triage or supplied test does not certify solution correctness or admit a source.

mappings.supports: Natural, synthetic-support and executable-trajectory candidates are already represented as separate source families and conditional branches.
mappings.does_not_support: No generated bank has independent quality, fidelity, outcome or finite-supply clearance.

gate_implications.family_partition: source and derived families must remain linked and disjoint
gate_implications.finite_supply: derived and discarded records counted separately

mappings.supports: Repository origin, family holds, transformed identities and limited cohort context are explicitly tracked.
mappings.does_not_support: The current cohort does not establish full-release eligible supply, behavioral correctness or complete event dependency graphs.

mappings.supports: The plan separates long-document supply from fixed-suffix, related-prefix and multi-file context evaluation.
mappings.does_not_support: Current inventories do not yet provide a measured dependency-distance field or prove useful long-range signal.

gate_implications.family_partition: context evaluation families must be held out

mappings.supports: The existing packets already define controls, matched exposure, protected confirmation, downstream fixed recipes and utility-per-token/GPU-hour measurements.
mappings.does_not_support: Design arithmetic is not a result; no study arm is launch-ready until source, runtime and parent gates close.

mappings.supports: Benchmark exclusion and family/duplicate gates are represented as separate requirements in the qualification and launch contracts.
mappings.does_not_support: Existing bounded audits do not establish population-wide contamination clearance for every candidate.

gate_implications.family_partition: benchmark and source-family joins remain open

next_actions: Add the contract fields to each candidate manifest during the source-specific mapping pass; preserve raw, retained, eligible and exposed counts separately.
Close source-use, family, correctness, finite-supply and runtime gates only with pinned evidence; do not infer closure from this mapping.
Add a bounded dependency-distance annotation/evaluation diagnostic before context recipe selection.
Select at most one code and one web contrast after their manifests qualify; protect confirmation before screening.
Keep the working mixture, arm counts and GPU reservations unchanged until qualified supply and runtime receipts support a revision.
admission_boundary: This mapping is review evidence only. It does not admit a source, authorize acquisition or training, change the 5,000-GPU-hour allocation or establish a positive data-efficiency claim.
